title: Public Education Leagues’ planned Riad al-Solh sit-in on Feb. 6
reason: The organizing leagues’ dated Feb. 6 statement says the sit-in planned for that day was cancelled because of severe storms and public safety; this is exclusion for non-occurrence of the announced action, not a zero-attendance estimate.
notes: The strike continued, but a work stoppage alone is not a qualifying public gathering. This does not exclude other teachers’ protests or imply none occurred elsewhere.
